commandOn.title: Command On
commandOn.description: Shell command to execute when the switch is turned on.

delayOn.title: Delay On
delayOn.description: Delay in milliseconds before executing the 'commandOn' after the switch is turned on.

delayOff.title: Delay Off
delayOff.description: Delay in milliseconds before resetting the switch to off after executing the 'commandOn'.
